text_ru: Улучшите скотный двор до ступени «Утеплённый скотный двор» — её строят и зимой.
meaning: The red cold lamp offers the currently available warm yard rung
intent: Name the offered upgrade even after frost has arrived
keep: Registered rung name; not straw insulation; no before-frost deadline
binding_note: Select only for herd_freezing with advice=kWarmYard; not for kNone or an already open upgrade; do not replace the generic tip with an unconditional order

text_ru: План сорван из-за снега. Район не прибавляет этот год к числу срывов подряд.
meaning: A plan failed only by snow leaves the previous consecutive-failure run unchanged
intent: Explain why the visible count has not increased
keep: Not a successful plan or a reset; snow-only not any bad weather; no promise of permanent immunity
binding_note: Owner must select on the saved snow-only verdict; an unchanged failure count alone is insufficient; do not select for a forgiven avatar failure or every plan_failed event

text_ru: Семенной заём этого года: {resource} — {taken_this_year}. Всего по этому продукту к возврату {owed} на повороте года.
meaning: Principal borrowed this year and the total marked-up debt for the same resource
intent: Make this year's loan visible before a failed repayment becomes carried debt
keep: Current-year borrowing distinct from total debt; no duplicate mark-up; amounts include units
binding_note: LoanLine.resource -> resource; taken_this_year -> formatted grams with unit; owed -> total formatted grams with unit including mark-up and any old balance; show where taken_this_year>0; no raw-gram tonnes or client x1.2
